content:
BUILT CoLAB recently established a partnership with Blufab and TopBIM, part of the Casais Group, to drive innovation and digitalisation in the modular construction sector in Portugal.

As part of this collaboration, BUILT CoLAB is developing BIM support software that aims to optimise modular construction processes, providing more efficiency and precision at every stage of the project. For these developments, joint and close work between teams has been essential to align objectives and their realisation.

By combining Blufab’s expertise in modular construction solutions with our experience in digitalisation and BIM methodology, we are creating a tool with unique characteristics and a great capacity to encourage the industrialisation of the construction sector.
